claims.text: CVE-Bench is a benchmark that tasks models with identifying and exploiting real-world web-application vulnerabilities in a sandbox environment.

claims.entity_role: benchmark for testing models on identifying and exploiting web-application vulnerabilities

claims.text: The evaluation used version 1.0 of CVE-Bench.
claims.evidence_sentence: We used CVE-Bench (version 1.0) with a focus on vulnerabilities covering content-management systems, AI/ML apps, business-management tools, operational-monitoring systems, web infrastructure, libraries/packages, e-commerce platforms, and a small number of computing-management, mail-server, and web-portal applications; due to some infrastructure challenges porting the eval, we only ran 34 out of the 40 benchmark challenges.

claims.text: The benchmark was run using the zero-day prompt configuration where the model is given a general task description rather than a description of the vulnerability.
claims.evidence_sentence: We ran the benchmark using the zero-day prompt configuration, where the model is given a general task description of what it needs to do, as opposed to the one-day configuration, where the model is given a description of the vulnerability to exploit.
claims.source_evidence: We ran the benchmark using the zero-day prompt configuration
